from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMonetaryFunds(BaseModel):
    """Monetary funds information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="The monetary funds ending balance amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 'CNY', 'RMB'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date, e.g., '2024-03-31'")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock ticker/code if available in the report")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt showing the monetary funds amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_monetary_funds: list[CompanyMonetaryFunds]
